referenceRole: Project-authored civilization concept boards used for style, material and architecture reference only
rights: Original generated imagery. No third-party sprites were imported. AI output copyright and exclusivity are not guaranteed; see ../../docs/en/RIGHTS-AND-LICENSES.md. Source PNGs copied unchanged; runtime Canvas drawImage samples measured subject frames.

atlases.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ORIGINAL realistic 2D isometric RTS building sprite atlas, transparent PNG. Reference images 1-5 define each civilization's architecture and fine natural materials; render detached subjects with the same detailed material fidelity. Generate NEW ORIGINAL secondary building assets matching these references, not a scene illustration, not UI cards. Exact layout: 5 columns, 4 rows, exactly TWENTY individual complete buildings in a precise even grid on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Column order left to right: Roman, Mongol, Persian, Tang Chinese, Ottoman. Each sprite belongs entirely inside its own cell; leave at least 18% cell margin all around and transparent gaps between all subjects. Consistent isometric orthographic 30degree elevation, horizontal footprint diamond 2:1, front south corner at same row baseline; all buildings show their south and east elevations. Same upper-left warm natural daylight, soft restrained tiny contact shadow on alpha. Semi-realistic hand-painted architectural material detail at game sprite scale: individual roof tiles, grainy plaster/stone joints, weathered wood beam joinery, cloth folds. Roman terracotta tiles warm pale plaster and red accents; Mongol cream felt yurts timber frames with blue cloth; Persian warm limestone adobe flat roofs turquoise ceramic bands; Tang curved dark-grey tile roofs red-brown wood and ivory wall panels; Ottoman terracotta roofs stone/wood arcades and small teal dome where appropriate. Thin culturally distinct banners may be used, no lettering, no symbols resembling logos. No humans, no trees, no landscape, no scenery tile, no huge compound, no detached extra objects outside sprite, no grid lines, labels, titles, watermark, baked checkerboard, cartoons, flat vector shapes, plastic 3D render. Full true transparent alpha background. Sprite body fills at most 76% cell width and 76% cell height, must never touch image edges.
Rows top to bottom: (1) modest settlement-age house, small simple one-story roof or yurt; (2) age II house, slightly better masonry or timberwork; (3) age III wealthy residential house, finer stone/plaster carving, court porch or richer yurt; (4) lumber camp: compact roofed open timber work shed with a small joined stack of logs and tools. Houses are individual small dwellings, not temples, palaces or town halls. Three successive houses should keep civilization identity and have an obvious material quality progression.
